subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should the final stack architecture permanently include the expanded QA runner contract, the Gateway admission helper, and Matrix dependency ownership in QA Lab?
rationale: The code is well-proven, but repository policy cannot infer maintainer intent for a compatibility-sensitive Plugin SDK expansion and availability-sensitive Gateway behavior introduced as part of a large staged refactor.

options.title: Approve the full architecture
options.body: Accept the SDK, Gateway, compatibility-shim, and dependency ownership changes after exact-head architecture and dependency gates pass.

options.title: Split cross-owner seams
options.body: Land the Matrix catalog migration separately and move the shared SDK or Gateway changes into focused owner-reviewed PRs.

options.title: Pause the migration stack
options.body: Hold this PR until the permanent qa-matrix removal and shared contract shape can be reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Approve the full architecture
recommendation.body: Accept the SDK, Gateway, compatibility-shim, and dependency ownership changes after exact-head architecture and dependency gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged predecessor and current stack make RomneyDa the strongest available owner for explaining and narrowing the intended architecture.
